title: Deployment Queue Standup — Sprint Annotations & Owner Chalkboard
body:
Date: 2026-03-12
Meeting: Deployment Queue Standup (15m) — Sprint annotations & owner chalkboard
Facilitator: Evan Morales
Attendees: Evan, Priya, Liam, Yuna, Carlos (on-call), Anya (infra sync)

Objective: Quick triage of the deployment queue, surface any canary risks, confirm hotfix slots and rollback owners for changes scheduled this window. Keep it short and action-oriented.

---- Queue Snapshot (top of queue) ----
1) REL-4857 — model-weights-rotation for dedicated pools (owner: Priya)
   - Type: config + model artifact swap, non-breaking but touches routing table
   - Target window: 2026-03-13 02:00-03:00 UTC
   - Canary plan: 5% traffic to pool-beta for 30m; measure p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate
   - Preflight: artifact checksum, model signature validation, smoke test generation on staging (Yuna)
   - Rollback owner: Priya (run revert-script v2)

2) REL-4823 — grpc-proxy upgrade to v1.14 (owner: Liam)
   - Type: infra dependency bump, potential client compatibility risk
   - Target window: 2026-03-13 05:00-06:00 UTC (low-traffic)
   - Canary plan: rolling restart on one rack, circuit-breaker at 2xx-to-5xx threshold
   - Hotfix slot reserved: Wednesday 08:00 UTC (slot A)
   - Rollback owner: Liam (proxy rollback playbook)

3) REL-4901 — optimize/kv-cache sticky-session changes (owner: Carlos)
   - Type: serving-runtime perf patch; touches cache eviction heuristics
   - Target window: 2026-03-14 01:00-02:30 UTC
   - Risk: small possibility of increased token latency for long prompts in dedicated pools
   - Telemetry owners: Carlos + Anya (slo dashboards updated pre-flight)

---- Canary Metrics to Watch (thresholds defined for this sprint) ----
- Latency: p50 baseline +30ms, p95 baseline +80ms -> abort canary if exceeded for >3 consecutive 5m windows
- Error budget: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 10m -> auto-rollover to fallback model variant
- Throughput: tokens/sec drop >20% relative to baseline -> flag and pause rollout
- Quality: sample prompt set eval (10 prompts) failure rate >10% -> manual stop

---- Preflight Checklist (must pass before lift) ----
- [ ] Artifact checksum verified in GCS and signed
- [ ] Smoke-generator run: basic generation smoke OK on staging (Yuna)
- [ ] Canary dashboard pre-populated + alerts wired to #deployments and SRE on-call
- [ ] Rollback runbook linked in PR and accessible to on-call (Liam)
- [ ] Customer-impact assessment: list of customers pinned to dedicated pools (Priya)
- [ ] Change ticket comment + owner ack in Jira (REL-xxx)

---- Hotfix Slots (reserved for critical rollbacks) ----
- Slot A: Wed 08:00 UTC — on-call: Carlos, backup: Priya
- Slot B: Thu 16:00 UTC — on-call: Liam, backup: Anya
Notes: Keep slots <=1 hour block; escalate to SRE if rollback crosses non-business hours impact window.

---- Known Risks & Mitigations ----
- Risk: routing inconsistency between pool-beta and pool-alpha causing state drift
  Mitigation: run routing reconciliation script (hash-checker) after canary ramp; maintain traffic mirror for 10m
- Risk: client SDKs with older gRPC backends may retry aggressively after proxy bump
  Mitigation: add temporary throttle and bump client-min-version policy in config; outreach to major customers pre-change
- Risk: cache eviction change may surface in long-context tests only
  Mitigation: extended soak on small subset of dedicated capacity for 48h post-rollout

---- Action Items (owners & due dates) ----
- Priya: finalize artifact signing and post checksum to REL-4857 by 2026-03-12 18:00 UTC
- Yuna: run full smoke suite on staging and paste logs into Jira REL-4857 by 2026-03-12 20:00 UTC
- Liam: validate proxy rollback steps and dry-run on canary rack by 2026-03-12 21:30 UTC
- Carlos: instrument extra latency histograms and add annotation to canary dashboard by 2026-03-12 19:30 UTC
- Anya: confirm KMS rotation window does not overlap with target windows (2026-03-13) and report in-thread by EOD

---- Postmortem Hooks (if canary aborted) ----
- Required: postmortem stub created within 24h, owner assigned, initial timeline posted within 48h
- Collect: perf profiles from canary and fallback, request traces with trace-ids list, representative prompts that failed quality checks

---- Quick Notes to Self (informal) ----
- Remember: avoid doing model artifact swaps at region-peak (asia morning). Aim for low-traffic region windows where possible.
- Slack threads to link in ticket: #deployments, #sre-incidents, PR6142 comment thread.
- Consider adding a "mini-canary" option (0.5% traffic for 10m) for config-only flips next sprint.

---- Parking Lot / Questions ----
- Q: Do we want to automatically create rollback PRs for every artifact swap? (Pros: faster rollback; Cons: PR churn) -> Discuss Fri ops sync
- Q: Should hotfix slots be centralized across infra and serving teams? (Carlos to propose matrix)

---- Summary / Decision Record ----
- Decision: Move REL-4857 to 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC with the listed canary plan; contingency hotfix Slot A reserved.
- Decision: Defer REL-4901 to 2026-03-14 to provide extra soak for kv-cache change suggestions.

Next sync: Tomorrow 2026-03-13 09:00 UTC if anything unexpected; otherwise end-of-window check-in post-deploy via async notes in Jira.

End of notes.
